record.context_brief: Positivity of -K_X under pseudo-effective tangent bundle
record.original_question: If X is a rationally connected manifold with pseudo-effective tangent bundle, is its anti-canonical divisor -K_X big?

evidence.quote: Problem 4.4 ([HIM21, Problem 3.13]). Let X be a rationally connected manifold with pseudo-effective tangent bundle. Then is the anti-canonical divisor -KX big?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $X$ be a smooth complex projective manifold. Recall that:

- $X$ is called rationally connected if any two general points of $X$ can be joined by a rational curve (equivalently, by a chain of rational curves).
- A vector bundle $E$ on $X$ is called pseudo-effective if, for every ample line bundle $A$ on $X$, there exists a positive integer $m$ and a positive integer $k$ such that $S^{mk}E \otimes A^{\otimes k}$ has a non-zero global section (equivalently, the tautological line bundle $\mathcal{O}_{\mathbb{P}(E^*)}(1)$ on the projectivization $\mathbb{P}(E^*)$ is pseudo-effective).
- A Cartier divisor $D$ on $X$ is called big if its Iitaka–Kodaira dimension equals $\dim X$, i.e. $h^0(X, \mathcal{O}_X(mD))$ grows like $m^{\dim X}$.
- $K_X$ denotes the canonical divisor of $X$.

Question: Suppose $X$ is a rationally connected projective manifold whose tangent bundle $T_X$ is pseudo-effective. Must the anti-canonical divisor $-K_X$ be big?
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as an open question in work on projective manifolds with pseudo-effective tangent bundle (Hosono–Iwai–Matsumura). Partial results exist: for rationally connected compact manifolds with strongly pseudo-effective tangent bundle, there is a finite cover whose universal cover has big anti-canonical bundle. Recent papers (2023–2025) on positivity of tangent sheaves and compact Kähler manifolds with nef anti-canonical bundle still treat this as an open problem in full generality.

status_evidence.title: On projective manifolds with pseudo-effective tangent bundle
status_evidence.snippet: Structure theorem: X with pseudo-effective T_X admits a smooth fibration to a flat manifold with rationally connected fibers; bigness of -K_X for the fibers is posed as a problem.
status_evidence.claim: The bigness of -K_X for rationally connected manifolds with pseudo-effective tangent bundle is posed as a problem.

status_evidence.title: On compact Kähler manifold with strongly pseudo-effective tangent bundle
status_evidence.snippet: For a rationally connected compact manifold with strongly pseudo-effective tangent bundle, there exists a finite cover whose universal cover has big anticanonical line bundle.
status_evidence.claim: Partial result under the stronger assumption of strongly pseudo-effective tangent bundle.

status_evidence.title: Positivity of tangent sheaves of projective varieties
status_evidence.snippet: Recent supplements and open problems concerning structure theorems for MRC fibrations of varieties with pseudo-effective tangent bundle.
status_evidence.claim: The general question remains open as of recent surveys.
